00040 BOOL CAliveObject::Walk( int dir, BOOL bServerCall )
00041 {
00042         if( !CanDoAction(AT_WALK) )return FALSE;
00043         int x = m_wX, y = m_wY;
00044         for( int i = 0;i < (int)GetWalkSpeed();i ++ )
00045         {
00046                 GETNEXTPOS(x,y,dir);
00047                 if( m_pMap->IsBlocked(x,y) )return FALSE;
00048         }
00049         DWORD   dwTime = 500;
00050         if( bServerCall )dwTime = 1000;
00051         if( !SetAction( AT_WALK, (e_direction)dir, x, y, dwTime ) )return FALSE;
00052         DWORD   dwView[] = { GetFeather(), 0 };
00053         SendAroundMsg(GetId(), SM_WALK, x, y, dir, (LPVOID)dwView, 8 );
00054         return TRUE;
00055 }

00065         }

00079 BOOL CAliveObject::Attack( int dir, BOOL bServerCall )
00080 {
00081         if( !CanDoAction(AT_ATTACK) )return FALSE;
00082         if( !SetAction(AT_ATTACK, (e_direction)dir, m_wX, m_wY, 600 ) )return FALSE;
00083 
00084         DWORD   dwView[] = { GetFeather(), GetStatus() };
00085         SendAroundMsg(GetId(), SM_ATTACK, m_wX, m_wY, dir, (LPVOID)dwView, 8 );
00086 
00087         int x = m_wX, y = m_wY;
00088         GETNEXTPOS( x, y, dir );
00089 
00090         CVArea * pArea = m_pMap->GetArea( x, y );
00091         if( pArea != NULL )
00092         {
00093                 CAliveObject * pObj = (CAliveObject*)pArea->FindObject( x, y, OBJ_PLAYER );
00094                 if( pObj != NULL )
00095                         pObj->BeAttack( this );
00096         }
00097 
00098         return TRUE;
00099 }

00124 VOID    CAliveObject::Say( const char * pszMsg, ... )
00125 {
00126 
00127         //pszMsg[100] = 0;
00128 
00129         char    szBuff[248];
00130         sprintf( szBuff, "%s:", GetName() );
00131         
00132         va_list vl;
00133         va_start( vl, pszMsg );
00134         vsprintf( szBuff+strlen( szBuff ), pszMsg, vl );
00135         va_end( vl);
00136         szBuff[120] = '\0';
00137         
00138         int size = EncodeMsg( g_CodedMsgBuffer, GetId(), SM_CHAT, 0xff00, 0, 0, (LPVOID)szBuff );
00139         if( CanRecvMsg() )
00140         {
00141                 OnAroundMsg( this, g_CodedMsgBuffer, size );
00142         }
00143         if( m_pArea == NULL )return;
00144         m_pArea->SendAroundMsg( this, g_CodedMsgBuffer, size );
00145 }
